senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. נָבַע)to burst forth, blow.

units: <cite ref="Sanhedrin 39b:15">Snh. 39ᵇ</cite> <he>יבא … ויִנָּבֵא על וכ׳</he> let Obadiah come … and prophesy against &c.; a. e.
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 4">Ex. R. s. 4</cite>. <he>כמה … שלא להִתְנַבְּאוֹת ונ׳ וכ׳</he> how much Jeremiah desired not to be a prophet, and yet he prophesied against his will.
<cite ref="Sotah 12b:11">Sot. 12ᵇ</cite> <he>נִתְנַבְּאָה שלא מדעתה</he> she prophesied unwittingly.
<cite ref="Sotah 12b:22">Ib.</cite> <he>מִתְנַבְּאָה ואינה וכ׳</he> she prophesied but did not know what she prophesied.
<cite ref="Megillah 14a:4">Meg. 14ᵃ</cite> <he>ארְבעים … נִתְנַבְּאוּ להם וכ׳</he> forty-eight prophets and seven prophetesses prophesied to Israel &c.
